input.subject: Quietly available - Cobble Hill co-op, no public listing
input.bodyText:
Hi all,

Owner is testing the waters privately before deciding whether to formally list - so this is off-market for now, no RLS, no signage.

55 Kane St, Apt 5C, Cobble Hill
1BR / 1BA prewar co-op, ~825 sf, high floor, open city views
Maintenance $1,180/mo, 2% flip tax paid by buyer
Board approval required, 20% min down, no pieds
Asking $795,000

Showable now to pre-qualified, board-friendly buyers. Co-broke 2.5%. Reply for the private link.

Marisol Vega
Brown Harris Stevens
